'''January 2000 Seattle tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Seattle, Washington on 15 January 2000. [[Douglas Harvilla]] won it. It is known from Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d177">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-16-seattle-washington-1-15-00d177/ seattle-washington-1-15-00], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 16 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-16-seattle-washington-1-15-00d177/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 January 2000
* '''Site:''' Seattle, Washington
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Douglas Harvilla]]
